en: This Apollo Saturn launch control T-minus three hours four minutes 32 seconds in counting right on time as far as the astronaut
zh: 這是阿波羅土星火箭發射控制，倒數三小時四分三十二秒，計時準時，對太空人來說一切正常
ja: これはアポロサターンの発射管制で、残り3時間4分32秒のカウントダウン中で、宇宙飛行士にとっては予定通りです
local: This Apollo Saturn launch control T-minus three hours four minutes 32 seconds in counting right on time as far as the astronaut
ja_pron: Kore wa Aporo Sātān no hassha kansei de, nokori san-jikan yon-pun san-jū-ni-byō no kauntodaun-chū de, uchū hikōshi ni totte wa yotei dōri desu
native: This Apollo Saturn launch control T-minus three hours four minutes 32 seconds in counting right on time as far as the astronaut

en: Count on his concern the prime crew now departing from their crew quarters ten nine
zh: 根據他的關注，主要組員現在正從他們的宿舍出發，倒數十、九
ja: 彼の関心に基づき、主要クルーは今、宿舎を出発し、カウントダウンは10、9です
local: Count on his concern the prime crew now departing from their crew quarters ten nine
ja_pron: Kare no kanshin ni motozuki, shuyō kurū wa ima, shukusha o shuppatsu shi, kauntodaun wa jū, kyū desu
native: Count on his concern the prime crew now departing from their crew quarters ten nine

en: It's on forward forward 40 feet down two and a half they come up from dust make that out
zh: 它向前，向前，下降40英尺，兩個半，他們從塵土中升起，辨認出來
ja: 前進しています。前へ、前へ、40フィート下がり、2フィート半、彼らは塵埃から現れました、それを確認してください
local: It's on forward forward 40 feet down two and a half they come up from dust make that out
ja_pron: Zenshin shiteimasu. Mae e, mae e, 40 fīto sagari, ni fīto han, karera wa jin'ai kara arawaremashita, sore o kakunin shite kudasai
native: It's on forward forward 40 feet down two and a half they come up from dust make that out

en: out of their step off the land
ja: 彼らは土地から一歩踏み出しました
local: out of their step off the land
ja_pron: Karera wa tochi kara ippo fumidashimashita
native: out of their step off the land

en: That's one small step for man
ja: それは人間にとっての小さな一歩です
local: That's one small step for man
ja_pron: Sore wa ningen ni totte no chiisana ippo desu
native: That's one small step for man

en: On by a fleet for mankind and here they start duty all alone. It's like much of a high desert of
zh: 這是為人類邁出的一大步，他們在這裡開始孤獨的任務。這裡就像美國的高原沙漠
ja: それは人類にとっての大きな一歩であり、彼らはここで一人で任務を始めます。ここはアメリカの高原砂漠のようです
local: On by a fleet for mankind and here they start duty all alone. It's like much of a high desert of
ja_pron: Sore wa jinrui ni totte no ōkina ippo de ari, karera wa koko de hitori de ninmu o hajimemasu. Koko wa Amerika no kōgen sabaku no yō desu
native: On by a fleet for mankind and here they start duty all alone. It's like much of a high desert of

en: But it's very pretty out here
ja: しかし、ここはとても美しいです
local: But it's very pretty out here
ja_pron: Shikashi, koko wa totemo utsukushii desu
native: But it's very pretty out here

en: Yes, indeed. They've got the flag up now and you can see the stars and stripes on the limit
zh: 是的，確實如此。他們現在已經升起旗幟，你可以看到星條旗在邊界上
ja: はい、まさにその通りです。彼らは今旗を掲げていて、境界に星条旗が見えます
local: Yes, indeed. They've got the flag up now and you can see the stars and stripes on the limit
ja_pron: Hai, masani sono tōri desu. Karera wa ima hata o kakagete ite, kyōkai ni seijōki ga miemasu
native: Yes, indeed. They've got the flag up now and you can see the stars and stripes on the limit
